sections.title: Uso
sections.lede: Stage + knobs homogeneos. Contrato de controls igual que los demos JSON. Layouts: split | panel.

blocks.html:
<iswc-playground layout="split" title="Playground" target="iswc-button">
  <iswc-button slot="stage" color="brand">Hola mundo</iswc-button>
  <script type="application/json" slot="spec">{
    "controls": [
      { "control": "select", "prop": "attr:color", "label": "color", "options": ["brand", "neutral", "success", "danger"] },
      { "control": "select", "prop": "attr:variant", "label": "variant", "options": ["filled", "outlined", "plain"] },
      { "control": "boolean", "prop": "attr:disabled", "label": "disabled", "group": "flags" }
    ]
  }</script>
</iswc-playground>
